LESSON: BIBLE STORIES: PETER AND JOHN IN THE TEMPLE

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible
Topic 2.2: Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How did Peter and John demonstrate faith in God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. discuss why Christians should stand firm in their faith

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: discuss why Christians should stand firm in their faith

Teach
• Today’s focus: discuss why Christians should stand firm in their faith.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “discuss why Christians should stand firm in their faith” using a school example.
• Model B for “discuss why Christians should stand firm in their faith” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "discuss why Christians should stand firm in their faith" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: discuss why Christians should stand firm in their faith

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: discuss why Christians should stand firm in their faith

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How did Peter and John demonstrate faith in God?
